mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 71 degrees and an air quality index of 57, under the light of a waning crescent moon.
The city is currently processing several development projects, including a site plan for 201 South Main Street and a review of the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park.

We have a packed schedule with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by a variety of activities tomorrow including the downtown farmers market and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on Saturday, August 6, an officer arrested a man for his fourth O W I offence after observing him driving erratically.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM to serve you. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
